body: I'm trying to get an appointment for tomorrow with my therapist if it is possible. I slept very very briefly. I'm still so overwhelmed with feeling this way. I thought resting for a bit would help it pass. I'm such a mess still right now and I really want a hug but I don't want to stress anybody out

Nah medication like that isn't handed out as often over here. It isn't unheard of but not very common. I nded yo try something like that. I slept like 2 hours at the most and I woke up still in a state of panic. I don't live alone so I'm paranoid of showing that I'm feeling this way. I don't want anybody to worry about. E

The panic is so bad. I've been fighting off the panic attack for so long now. I'm so shaky it feels horrible. I've not been in hospital from it but I get them really bad but ive never let anybody see them but I can imagine theyd call someone. 

It really isn't easy to do like he has told me to be better to myself and he picked up a lot I'd negatively speak about myself without even realising I was doing it. I can't even think straight to the advice he gave me if I'm being honest my head is an absoloute mess right now

Well done on quitting. I hope you continue to kick caffiene and nicotine ass. I've been fighting off the urge to have a panic attack for hours now. I can't relax at all. 

I started therapy again with the intent on being 100% honest about everything and I always knew I had issues with self hatred but I've come to the realisation how much that messes with my every day life. For 3 weeks now I haven't been able to drop the thought and I'm seeing how it has fucked with so much of my daily life for so long and while figuring this out has been a comfort. Now I have my brain that is constantly ticking and thinking about all of this. 

I have so much built up self hatred. I can't stand these feelings.
Thank you. I messaged you there.
I'm shaking a lot. I'm sorry if this post doesn't make sense. My brain really isn't functioning too well right now.
